coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: 255 Berry
record.summary: A seven-story building at 255 Berry St.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is Assessor lot 8708009 (3,989 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. The lot is condominium-mapped: 100 Assessor lots share this outline (the map lot 8708009 and 99 per-unit lots), so the outline is the building's shared lot, not any one unit. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the surveyed building footprint (OpenStreetMap (relation 3831604, 255 Berry St)); 94% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 91% of the lot.
notes.digitized_from: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 8708009 (mapped 2003-09-22; active); the earlier outline came from: OpenStreetMap (relation 3831604, 255 Berry St)

milestones.text: 255 Berry completed, about 2004: the DataSF Assessor roll (2025) gives year built 2004 for lot 8708009 and the building's per-unit lots, and the developer's own project page gives a 2001-2004 development date range (a range, not a completion date); the page also gives $60,000,000 project cost, 99 units, architect McLarand Vasquez Emsiek & Partners

changes.text: 255 Berry now shows its construction permit as completed on Aug 10, 2004.

The map notes called the developer Signature Properties and said the building was built in 2004; the developer's own page says Signature Development Group and gives a 2001-2004 development range, so a dated correction was added. The 'Signature I' naming and the milestone's 'Channel Park Condominiums' name are not on any cited page and were removed. The notes now give the 99 units and the architect from the developer's project page, which is cited for the residential use.

Its summary is limited to what its cited source was re-read to confirm that day; fuller details given in this record's other notes (developer, architect, unit count, year built) were left out of the summary where that source didn't state them. Not yet researched: no milestones, costs or facts.
